name: crossbyte
description: Cross-platform Haxe runtime and networking framework for event-driven applications and services: TCP, WebSocket, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, reliable UDP, WebRTC data channels with STUN/TURN NAT traversal, IPC, RPC, and systems tools.
releasenote: 2.0.0, in development: local IPC runs on native-ipc, and a 2.0.0 program and a 1.0 one cannot meet over a local name.
